characters.summary: Darkseid is the tyrannical ruler of Apokolips, utilizing overwhelming physical might, indestructible durability, and the devastating Omega Beams to incinerate foes.
limitations: Omega Beams can occasionally be dodged or deflected by extreme speed or mirrors

sources.supports: General overview of Darkseid's powers, Omega Beams, and Apokolips origins.

feats.claim: Fired Omega Beams that tracked and incapacitated multiple superheroes.

notableResults.note: Frequent clashes with no definitive permanent victor.

campaignTags.claim: Darkseid flies through innate New God physiology.

unknowns: Exact limits of his physical strength vary across different reboots and storylines.

characters.summary: Having absorbed the remnants of the Empty Hand and multi-versal energies, this version of Darkseid possesses enhanced reality-warping and multiversal scaling capabilities alongside his traditional Apokoliptian arsenal.

mechanisms: Conceptual immunity to standard physical attacks

limitations: Dependent on maintaining multiversal energy resonance
characters.formDifferences: Massively amplified multiversal power scale compared to base Darkseid, incorporating reality-warping attributes.

sources.supports: General history and Infinite Frontier updates.

feats.claim: Confronted the Justice League across multiple reality shards during Infinite Frontier.

unknowns: The full permanent extent of his post-Crisis absorption feats.

characters.summary: Deadshot is the world's most accurate assassin, utilizing custom wrist-mounted machine guns and advanced firearms with exceptional ricochet calculations.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to close-range melee onslaughts if caught off guard
limitations: Dependent on ammunition supply and firearm functionality

sources.supports: Overview of Deadshot's marksmanship, equipment, and Suicide Squad history.

feats.claim: Hit a target from a mile away with extreme precision.

campaignTags.claim: Uses custom wrist-mounted guns and targeting optics.

unknowns: Exact number of confirmed kills across various alternate timelines.

characters.summary: Death is the anthropomorphic personification of death and the second-eldest of the Endless, possessing absolute dominion over mortality and the end of all things.
weaknesses: Bound by cosmic rules governing the Endless
limitations: Cannot violate the cosmic charter of the Endless

sources.supports: Overview of Death's nature as an Endless sibling and her role in the DC universe.

feats.claim: Will be the last entity alive to turn off the lights when the universe ends.

notableResults.note: Claims every living being when their time arrives.

unknowns: True limits of her power outside her assigned domain.

limitations: Limited to human physical peaks augmented by experimentation

sources.supports: Overview of Deathstroke's enhanced abilities, military background, and weapons.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple members of the Teen Titans in single and group combat.

notableResults.note: Fought to stalemates in close quarters.

campaignTags.claim: Uses customized armor, explosive charges, and tactical gear.
Possesses a rapid healing factor due to military augmentation.

unknowns: Exact efficacy against high-tier cosmic beings.

characters.summary: Equipped with the divine Godkiller sword forged by Hephaestus, this version of Deathstroke can battle and slay powerful divine entities.

mechanisms: Enhanced durability from divine armor components

weaknesses: Dependence on the integrity of the Godkiller blade
limitations: Sword can be disarmed or separated from him
characters.formDifferences: Wields the Godkiller sword, granting him the capacity to fight cosmic and divine entities.

notableResults.note: Successfully fought divine opponents with the Godkiller.

campaignTags.claim: Wields the divine Godkiller sword forged by Hephaestus.

weaknesses: Vulnerable if separated from the Helmet of Nabu
limitations: Host body can be influenced or overwhelmed by Nabu's consciousness

characters.summary: Doctor Manhattan possesses absolute quantum manipulation, atomic disassembly, precognition, and omnipresent awareness across spacetime.
weaknesses: Tachyon fields can disrupt his precognition
limitations: Cannot perceive events clouded by tachyon interference

sources.supports: Overview of Doctor Manhattan's atomic and quantum powers from Watchmen.

feats.claim: Disintegrated armed soldiers into dust with a mere gesture.

notableResults.note: Chose to alter the timeline rather than destroy Superman.

campaignTags.claim: Levitates and flies via quantum control.

unknowns: Whether his consciousness can be entirely erased by high-tier multiversal forces.

characters.summary: Dream (Morpheus) is the anthropomorphic personification of dreams, stories, and the imagination, wielding immense conceptual power within and outside the Dreaming.
weaknesses: Bound by ancient rules of the Endless and vulnerable when stripped of his totems of office
limitations: Power is severely diminished if separated from his magical implements

sources.supports: Overview of Dream's abilities, role as one of the Endless, and realm of the Dreaming.

feats.claim: Trapped mortals and immortals within endless slumber.

conditional.dependsOn: Possession of his Helm, Dreamstone, and Sand

unknowns: Full extent of his power outside of the Dreaming.
